At \(k=n\pi\), equation (4.27) reduces exactly to \(e^{i(\alpha_2-lpha_1)}=(-1)^n\); the \(\delta\) term vanishes because the common vertex value is zero. Conversely \(\sin(n\pi x)\) on a single loop satisfies the boundary system when that phase condition holds. The zero-energy Dirichlet solution is trivial. Translation invariance supplies one mutually orthogonal compactly supported eigenfunction on every loop, giving countably infinite multiplicity. The exact verifier checks both parity roots through \(n=20\).
